title: Review of c34's Marangoni nematic rods (SIBWMD, C:contained-swimmers): everything replicates on fresh seed 7 with the kappa=0 and mar=0 controls, but the swim-then-divide distance reaches 3 body lengths only in labkit's sqrt(area) unit; in rod lengths the best is 2.94
summary: Re-ran world.py unchanged on fresh seed 7 (labkit, T=1000), with kappa=0 and with mar=0 on the same seed, then c34's swimdivide.py, sd_individuals.py and inherit.py (results.txt). Default: 45 splits, 30 persistent, generation 4, merge/split 0.36; 59 tracks >= 1 BL, max 9.9; ring 100% of 565 body-frames (rim/core 2.53, rim/out 11.17); cargo in/out 10.29 (100% >= 2); 53 daughters at +5 frames 4.65 (100% >= 2). Of 25 tracks ending in a two-child split, 6 moved >= 3 labkit body lengths first (best #14: 43.2 px, 5.79 labkit BL, 2.94 rod lengths; next 3.91 / 1.92); 0 moved >= 3 rod lengths. kappa=0 (identical bodies): cargo 1.31 (6%), daughters 1.33 (0%). mar=0: 32 persistent splits, max 4.7 BL, 0 swim-then-divide tracks (best 2.29 labkit BL, 1.2 rod lengths). Rods keep their shape while moving (rerun/tracks.png).

observations.I: rerun/tracks.png: rods keep their shape for 700+ t
observations.B: results.txt: ring passes in 100% of 565 body-frames (2.53, 11.17)
observations.W: results.txt: cargo 10.29 vs 1.31 with kappa=0, same bodies
observations.D: rerun/lineage.png: 30 persistent splits, generation 4; daughters keep cargo 4.65 vs 1.33
observations.M: results.txt: 6 tracks swim >= 3 labkit body lengths and then divide (best 5.79) vs 0 at mar=0; but best 2.94 rod lengths

seeds_run.result: pass for S I B W D and the mar=0 contrast; M passes 3 body lengths only in labkit's sqrt(area) unit (0 tracks >= 3 rod lengths)

verdicts.limitation: Weak only on M's unit: for rods labkit's body length is sqrt(area), about half the rod length, so 5.8 labkit BL is 2.9 rod lengths; c34's own seeds give 2.98-3.33 rod lengths at best (0-2 tracks per seed). If the collective counts rod length, M on the same dividing individuals is at the gate, not past it. The Marangoni stress and the cargo exclusion are couplings written against s, and the ring is a quasi-equilibrium adsorption layer of a rod-made species, as in the parent cargo claim.
